menarche_mean.note: Mean offset of the menarche after the puberty timing theta_i (delta ~ normal(0.2, 0.6), FERTILITY_MENARCHE); a play value: the menarche lies about a year after the growth peak.

menarche_sd.note: Standard deviation of the offset of the menarche.

menarche_low.note: The menarche is held on [theta_i - 1, theta_i + 3]: the lower bound relative to theta_i.

menarche_high.note: The upper bound of the menarche relative to theta_i.

female_ramp.note: The woman's factor rises from 0 at the menarche to 1 over this many years (smoothstep); 0.5 after 1.5 years [W5.6a].

female_decline_from.note: From this age the woman's factor declines linearly.

female_decline_to.note: At this age the woman's factor is 0; at 40 it is 0.5 [W5.6b].

male_lead.note: The man's factor is 0 until this long before theta_i (at the growth peak of the mean curve).

male_ramp.note: The man's factor rises to 1 over this many years (smoothstep); no draw of its own, the spread lies in theta_i.

male_decline_from.note: From this age the man's factor declines linearly.

male_floor.note: The man's factor declines to this value and stays there; at 57.5 it is 0.7 [W5.6c].

male_decline_to.note: At this age the man's factor reaches its floor.
